# Tree Model

## Purpose
The Tree Model provides entities for representing hierarchical structures, consisting of trees and their constituent nodes.

## Key Entities
- **Tree**: The root entity for a hierarchy.
- **TreeNode**: An individual element within a tree, which can have parent and children nodes.

## Class Diagram
```mermaid
classDiagram
    Baseclass <|-- Tree
    Baseclass <|-- TreeNode
    Baseclass <|-- TreeNodeToUser

    Tree "1" *-- "many" TreeNode
    TreeNode "many" -- "0..1" TreeNode : parent
    TreeNodeToUser "many" -- "1" TreeNode

    class Tree {
        +String name
    }
    class TreeNode {
        +String name
        +String value
        +TreeNode parent
    }
```
